title: fzf: Arbitrary command execution via bash arithmetic expansion on unvalidated layout size in fzf-tmux (-l/-u attached…
description: The fzf-tmux script in fzf versions prior to 0.74.5 improperly validates layout size arguments in attached form options (-l/-u), allowing bash arithmetic expansion to execute arbitrary commands. Additionally, unquoted tmux popup geometry options enable injection of tmux flags, leading to command execution via environment variable sourcing. This local vulnerability requires attacker-controlled input to layout arguments and affects the invoking user. A fix is available in version 0.74.5.
